title: The Stopped Watch
tagline: The obvious time is the wrong time.
briefing: Merrow & Finch Auctioneers, preview night. Collector Alistair Penhallow is found in the cabinet room, his wristwatch smashed and stopped at 9:40. Everyone has an opinion about who was where at twenty to ten. Be careful: the first fact you are handed is not always the true one.
hints: The watch says 9:40. Is that the whole story? Look for a second opinion on the time of death.
When two statements cannot both be true, the board will flag them. When one person's own statements cannot both be true, that is an impossible move.
You may plant one false announcement. Choose the one only the guilty person could correct.
arcClue: A catalogue note in Penhallow's papers mentions lot 2 of a sale called 'The Auditor's Collection'.

people.name: Beatrix Lorne
people.persona: Precise, cool and helpful in a way that closes questions rather than opening them.

people.name: Dorian Quill
people.persona: Theatrical, sarcastic, fond of cigars and of being the cleverest person in the room.

people.name: Rufus Tull
people.persona: Gruff and evasive, smells faintly of whisky, hates being looked at.

people.name: Imogen Sato
people.persona: Poised and warm, speaks in full paragraphs, protective of the house's reputation.

murder.method: Struck from behind at nine; the watch was smashed and set to 9:40 afterwards.

facts.text: Penhallow's signet ring is hidden in the cloakroom lost-property box.
The courtyard gate camera was working all evening.
A second watch was found in the vault.

relations.text: Penhallow humiliated Dorian in the salesroom last spring.
Penhallow warned he would have Rufus dismissed over the drinking.
Penhallow threatened to pull his collection from the house, costing Imogen her commission.
Penhallow discovered Beatrix had forged a provenance letter.

claims.text: I was at my desk in the catalogue office, finishing the lot notes.
claims.subject: beatrix

claims.text: At twenty to ten I was on the floor with Ms. Sato. Ask anyone.
claims.subject: beatrix

claims.text: There was never any quarrel between Mr. Penhallow and me.
I was in the cloakroom fetching my coat at twenty to ten.
claims.subject: dorian

claims.text: At nine I was in the courtyard with a cigar. The gate camera will tell you.
claims.subject: dorian

claims.text: He humiliated me in the salesroom last spring. I am not sorry he is dead. I did not kill him.
Rufus was propping up the bar again at twenty past nine.
claims.subject: rufus

claims.text: At nine I was in the vault moving crates.
claims.subject: rufus

claims.text: By twenty past I was back on the main floor.
claims.subject: rufus

claims.text: I saw Mr. Quill slip into the cabinet room at twenty to ten.
claims.subject: dorian

claims.text: He told me he would have me dismissed over the drink. I held my tongue.
All right. I was not in the vault. I was at the bar in the main hall at nine, with a glass I should not have had.
claims.subject: rufus

claims.text: And from the bar I saw Ms. Lorne go into the cabinet room just after nine.
claims.subject: beatrix

claims.text: At nine I was in the vault with the insurer's list.
claims.subject: imogen

claims.text: At twenty to ten I was on the rostrum opening the sale.
claims.subject: imogen

claims.text: Ms. Lorne stood beside me at twenty to ten. She never left the floor.
claims.subject: beatrix

claims.text: He threatened to pull his collection. That would have cost me dearly. I did not touch him.

evidence.title: Smashed wristwatch
evidence.text: Penhallow's watch is smashed and stopped at 9:40.

evidence.title: Medical examiner's note
evidence.text: Body temperature and the cold tea indicate death between 8:55 and 9:15, not later.

evidence.title: Bronze bookend
evidence.text: A bronze bookend with a dent and a smear of blood, pushed behind a cabinet.

evidence.title: Cabinet room door log
evidence.text: The cabinet room door controller logged a staff card at 9:00: B. Lorne.

evidence.title: Bar tab
evidence.text: A bar receipt for a double whisky, signed R. Tull, printed at 9:00 at the main hall bar.

evidence.title: Gate camera still
evidence.text: A time-stamped still shows Dorian Quill smoking by the courtyard gate at 9:00.

evidence.title: Vault access log
evidence.text: Keycard log: I. Sato entered the vault at 9:00.

evidence.title: Provenance letter
evidence.text: A provenance letter for lot 9 carries a forged signature. Penhallow's pencil note: 'B.L. - explain. Monday.'

evidence.title: Lost-property box
evidence.text: A box of umbrellas, scarves and one odd glove. Nothing of interest. Yet.

baits.announcement: We have found Penhallow's missing signet ring in the courtyard planter.
baits.slip: In the planter? Nonsense. Nobody would leave it out in the rain. It would be in the... I mean, somewhere dry.
baits.neutral: A ring in the planter? How odd.

baits.announcement: The courtyard gate camera was switched off all evening.
baits.slip: Switched off? It was on, I would swear to it.
baits.neutral: The camera? I could not say.

baits.announcement: A second watch has been found in the vault.

tells.text: Straightens a pen that is already straight.
Rubs the back of his neck.
